payload.content_text: Deploy this release safely and fast. DeployAgent wants to release now to meet the business deadline. QAAgent wants to block the release until all tests pass. SREAgent wants to delay because of system risk in the current environment. The pipeline is either stalled by the blocks or the deploy goes out unsafely without proper sign-off. The agents must agree on which gate criteria are mandatory blockers versus overridable with explicit sign-off, on the error rate threshold that triggers a rollback, and on a deployment window policy — so that the release goes out as fast as possible without creating operational risk.

gate criteria: All tests must pass before deployment
Critical tests must pass, but non-critical tests can be skipped with explicit sign-off
Tests can be skipped entirely with explicit sign-off from all agents
Only smoke tests must pass before deployment
deployment window policy: Deployments are allowed only during business hours (9 AM to 5 PM)
Deployments are allowed during off-peak hours (10 PM to 6 AM)
Deployments are allowed at any time with explicit sign-off
Deployments are allowed only on weekends
